 Print Aadarsha Kutumbam. Venkatesh Daggubati 's 'Aadarsha Kutumbam – House No. 47' has begun its theatrical journey with a notable opening across domestic and overseas markets. Directed by Trivikram Srinivas , the Telugu family drama features Srinidhi Shetty as the female lead. The film arrived in cinemas on October 30, following multiple changes to its release schedule. According to Sacnilk, the movie collected Rs 16.65 cr in worldwide gross earnings on its opening day. Its India net collection stood at Rs 9.50 cr, while the domestic gross reached Rs 11.15 cr. Overseas markets contributed Rs 5.50 cr, accounting for 33% of the worldwide earnings. The Indian market made up the remaining 67%. 'Aadarsha Kutumbam – House No. 47' opens at the box office
 The film's opening-day performance shows contributions from audiences in India and international territories. Its domestic gross accounted for the larger share of the worldwide total, while overseas collections provided an additional boost. The film's India net figure was lower than its gross because the latter includes applicable taxes. Andhra Pradesh and Telangana emerged as the leading domestic markets for the Venkatesh-starrer. The combined territories contributed the largest share of its India gross. Karnataka followed, while Tamil Nadu and the rest of India recorded comparatively smaller collections. Kerala registered the lowest contribution among the listed regions. The state-wise figures reported by Sacnilk are given below: | State/Region | Day 1 gross | |---|---:| | Andhra Pradesh/Telangana | Rs 9.25 cr | | Tamil Nadu | Rs 30 lakhs | | Karnataka | Rs 1.40 cr | | Kerala | Rs 2 lakhs | | Rest of India | Rs 18 lakhs | | India total | Rs 11.15 cr | Venkatesh Daggubati and Srinidhi Shetty headline the cast
 Venkatesh Daggubati plays the central character in 'Aadarsha Kutumbam – House No. 47', with Srinidhi Shetty portraying his wife. The film also features Nara Rohith and Nivetha Pethuraj in important roles. The supporting cast includes Yuvina, Raj Prajwal, Rao Ramesh, Satya, Brahmaji, Vennela Kishore and Raghu Babu. Trivikram Srinivas wrote and directed the project, which is also referred to as 'AK 47'. The movie's theatrical arrival followed a series of changes to its planned release date. It eventually reached cinemas on October 30 and is getting decent reviews from the audience. What lies ahead for 'Aadarsha Kutumbam – House No. 47'?
 The opening-day figures provide an early indication of the film's performance across different markets. Its strong contribution from Andhra Pradesh and Telangana, along with overseas earnings, shaped its initial box office result. The next few days will be important in determining whether the movie can maintain its opening momentum. DISCLAIMER: The box office numbers and the data in this article are compiled from public and industry sources. All figures are approximate unless explicitly mentioned, offering a fair representation of the movie's box office performance. These totals may change as official studio data is updated or as additional international market reports are finalized. This data is provided by us for informational and entertainment purposes only.
